name: RAT KING DICE
description: A fast, loud, anarchic dice game played with seven irregular resin dice — each face hand-engraved with symbols representing the Gray Zone power structures: the creditor, the enforcer, the medic, the rat, the broker, the ghost, and the empty — in which players build and betray temporary alliances each round, with the 'Rat King' role rotating to whoever holds the most betrayal tokens. Sets are manufactured in small batches by a rotating collective of the Gray Zone artisans and no two sets are identical.
story_hooks: A particular set of Rat King dice keeps appearing at scenes of violence — always present at the table the night something goes wrong.
An enforcer starts playing in the Gray Zone bars specifically to identify who takes the 'ghost' role most often — those players keep disappearing.
A Tier 3 anthropologist studying the Gray Zone social rituals through Rat King Dice play patterns gets in far deeper than academic research.
related_entities: Street Custom 'Rat King' Cluster Munition Launcher
